query gameMeta {
  gameMeta {
    gameLevels {
      objectId
      createDate
      updateDate
      deleteDate
      gameSeasonId
      title
      finishScore
      rewardGameItemId
      rewardClaimed
    }
    currentSeason {
      objectId
      name
      startDate
      endDate
      passGameItemId
      description
    }
    studentHouse
    studentGameItemId
    studentGameItemActivated
    selfPoints
    housesPoints {
      code
      name
      rank
      points
    }
    attendance
    dailyPractice {
      ...practiceFields
    }
    studentStats {
      points
      tasks
    }
  }
}

fragment practiceFields on Practice {
  id
  name
  type
  startDate
  endDate
  progress
  durationMinutes
  leftTime
  finishTime
  usedTime
  executionStatus
  expired
  processingTime
  content {
    ...practiceContentFields
  }
  assignedByUserId
  isTerminated
}

fragment practiceContentFields on PracticeContent {
  subThemes {
    categoryId
    themeId
    subThemeId
    score
    subThemeName
    subThemeNumber
    type
    isDeleted
    subjectId
  }
  tasks {
    categoryId
    themeId
    subThemeId
    subThemeName
    subThemeNumber
    taskId
    processed
  }
  courseModules {
    moduleId
    name
    courseId
    categoryId
  }
}

query catalogCategoryByCode($categoryCode: String!) {
  catalogCategoryByCode(categoryCode: $categoryCode) {
    id
    parentId
    parentCode
    name
    shortDescription
    description
    fullDescription
    image
    lottie
    imageOffsetX
    imageOffsetY
    imageScale
    color
    weight
    iconUrl
    tariffTitle
    code
    size
    type
    availabilityType
    tags
    classId
    subjectId
    coursesObjectIds
    externalMaterial
    hidden
    isActive
    practiceId
    durationMinutes
    validFromDate
    validToDate
    practiceId
    bannerComponent
    updatedAt
    educont
    educontOnly
    educontCourses {
      externalId
      label
      link
    }
    randomizedContent {
      classId
      subjectId
      taskQuantity
    }
    showKeys
    teacherThemeGroupMode
    eor
    badges
    about
    additionalInfo
    name
    childCategories {
      ...catalogCategoryFields
    }
  }
}

fragment catalogCategoryFields on Category {
  id
  parentId
  parentCode
  name
  shortDescription
  description
  fullDescription
  image
  lottie
  imageOffsetX
  imageOffsetY
  imageScale
  color
  weight
  code
  size
  type
  availabilityType
  tags
  classId
  subjectId
  coursesObjectIds
  externalMaterial
  hidden
  isActive
  practiceId
  durationMinutes
  validFromDate
  validToDate
  practiceId
  bannerComponent
  updatedAt
  educont
  educontOnly
  iconUrl
  educontCourses {
    externalId
    label
    link
  }
  randomizedContent {
    classId

    taskQuantity
  }
  showKeys

  eor

}
